# pawnbook is a self-hosted single-user tool with no authentication.
# Several standard web-security headers don't apply in this context.

column3: Incomplete or No Cache-control Header — API responses are intentionally uncached
Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled — deprecated header, not a finding
Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion — cm-chessboard loaded locally
X-Frame-Options Header Not Set — no embedding threat for a self-hosted tool
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing — acceptable for a local tool
Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set — not running HTTPS locally
Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set — self-hosted, no third-party injection threat
Permissions Policy Header Not Set — not applicable
Timestamp Disclosure — Epoch timestamps in API responses are intentional
Cross-Domain Misconfiguration — no CORS needed for same-origin SPA
